text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, I'm writing this letter on the train back. It made me so happy seeing everyone again after all that time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Did you know? Mifuyu said that right when she was thinking about giving up her dream, she saw me run and that made her decide to keep trying!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I just can't believe that when people see me run—me with all my worries—they feel inspired. It's a pretty swell feeling. Just the motivation I need!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I wanna be a city girl who loves herself and who people love back! And not just for my personality or looks, but for my talent as well!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna spend the rest of the year training, then run in the Osaka Hai next year! Everyone's gonna see just how gutsy this Morioka girl is!
